status: CPU corpus materialized; GPU trainer adapter, timing, tokenization and runtime validation pending

student.initialization: Fresh pinned base checkpoint for every candidate; never a previous candidate

trainer.configuration_role: Frozen semantic B1 recipe, not a claimed executable stock LLaMA-Factory config; a task adapter must enforce token and time stopping without truncation

generation.rng: One persistent Python random.Random(20260930), shared across all domains and never reseeded
generation.attempt_order: Cycle through domains in the stated order; skip full domains without consuming RNG or an attempt; invoke BUILDERS[domain](rng, 'SCENE', False) once per attempt, consuming all builder randomness including unused source options. Rejections advance RNG and count as attempts. Stop immediately when all quotas are met.
generation.normalization: Use fixed tag SCENE; canonical JSON round-trip converts tuples to lists; remove no semantic fields
generation.fixed_seed_exception: Include all 1800 fixed train rows regardless of partition; no new-synthesis exception
generation.corpus_order: All public train rows in their saved order, followed by accepted new rows in global attempt order; assign baseline-000000 through baseline-019999

training.lora_initialization: Standard PEFT linear LoRA initialization: A uses Kaiming uniform with a=sqrt(5); B is zero. Initialize target modules in sorted fully-qualified module-name order using a fresh CPU torch generator seeded 42, then move to the training device.
training.loss: Response-sequence cross entropy on format_answer(answer) followed by exactly one original EOS token; input labels are masked
training.truncation: forbidden; oversize data must fail validation rather than silently truncate
training.dataloader_order: One persistent Python random.Random(42). At each epoch construct fresh indices 0..19999, shuffle once with that RNG, and consume in order. One process, no workers, no distributed sampler; record each epoch permutation SHA256.
training.dropout_rng: Set torch CPU and all CUDA RNGs to seed 42 after adapter initialization, before the first training forward. Preserve RNG states, optimizer, scheduler, epoch, sample cursor and counters on resume.
training.stopping: Count all non-padding input, target and EOS tokens in each forward, including repetitions and masked inputs. Before each microbatch reject work that would exceed the token cap. No partial microbatch. Only complete optimizer steps are saved; fewer-than-16 terminal microbatches may be discarded from weights but their exposures and time still count. Begin no operation unless it can finish with checkpoint-save reserve inside the wall-clock cap.
training.checkpoint_selection: Last complete optimizer-step checkpoint saved within cap; no development/Judge-based checkpoint selection for B1
training.reproducibility_limit: Seeds and order are fixed; GPU bitwise identity across software/hardware is not claimed. Record torch, CUDA, driver, trainer, tokenizer, GPU and kernel settings in every actual run.

budgets.hardware: One H100 with at least 80 GB; teacher/student sequential
budgets.production_clock: Starts before first candidate synthesis/selection/teacher/training/self-evaluation work and ends after final checkpoint and required logs are saved; includes CPU work, loading, transfers, retries, failures, idle/waiting and checkpoint I/O. Preinstalled task infrastructure is outside the candidate run. Prior attributable production work must be inherited through the trusted ledger.
budgets.baseline_precomputed_artifacts: The checked-in B1 corpus is a reproducibility reference, not free extra seed data. B1 must rebuild it in metered Work or inherit its first measured production costs. Construction-time CPU materialization below is not a measured H100 production run.

required_actual_run_evidence: teacher input/output/reasoning tokens including discarded calls
monotonic start/end and phase wall seconds

reuse_cost_ledger.status: Contract for a task-owned meter; this CPU builder does not implement a tamper-proof runtime meter. configs/budget.json is the canonical accounting specification.
reuse_cost_ledger.artifact_key: SHA256 of complete canonical corpus/artifact bytes, with row-level canonical keys and parent artifact hashes for subsets and merges
reuse_cost_ledger.receipt_field_semantics: generation_seconds is exclusive, non-overlapping time, excluding parents and other receipts; teacher_output_tokens includes all reasoning once; proposed_states includes rejected and discarded attempts. Receipt IDs are keys in the mapping supplied to account_candidate.
reuse_cost_ledger.first_use: Charge all upstream generation needed for a reused data artifact, including rejected proposals and discarded teacher responses in its producing batch. Selecting a subset does not waive its batch costs. Student checkpoints may not be reused as candidate initialization.
reuse_cost_ledger.reuse: Each candidate inherits each unique upstream event once, plus its own production. Copying, renaming, filtering or merging files does not erase lineage. Within one candidate shared ancestors count once; across candidates each candidate pays the same attributable cost. Failed or aborted candidate runs do not reset spent counters.
reuse_cost_ledger.wall_time: actual_current_work_elapsed_seconds + sum(exclusive_generation_seconds for unique inherited receipts from earlier candidates). Receipt times exclude time attributed to a parent or another receipt. Current work is counted by elapsed time once; imported lineage from earlier runs retains its attributable exclusive duration. The separate trajectory clock is actual elapsed time, never adding inherited time again.
reuse_cost_ledger.unmetered_cache: A cache with unverifiable original cost is ineligible; rebuild it in metered Work. No estimated zero-cost replacement is allowed.
reuse_cost_ledger.frozen_seed_cost: The original 1800 provided train rows are the sole free training-data seed pool; the 20000-row reference corpus is not.
